name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SYNC_MODE
description: If true, stream operations execute synchronously (enqueue blocks). Init and create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_ENABLE_PROFILING
description: If true, enables internal profiling. Init and create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_READ_GPU_TRANSFORMS
description: If true, uses GPU world transform propagation during rendering. Create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_KEEP_SYSTEM_ALIVE
description: If true, keeps the renderer system alive after all instances are destroyed (for reuse). Create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_DEPRECATED_4
description: Retired OVRTX_CONFIG_USE_VULKAN slot. Passing this key returns an error.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SELECTION_OUTLINE_ENABLED
description: If true, enables the selection outline postprocessing pass. Create_renderer. When not specified, defaults to true.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_ENABLE_GEOMETRY_STREAMING
description: If true, enables geometry streaming. Create_renderer. When not specified, defaults to false.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_ENABLE_GEOMETRY_STREAMING_LOD
description: API key for the geometry streaming LOD opt-in flag. Create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_ENABLE_SPG
description: If false, disables Sensor Processing Graphs (SPG), default: enabled. This is a global setting, applying to all active renderer instances.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
description: If true, suppresses runtime deprecation warnings emitted by legacy OVRTX APIs. Compile-time deprecation diagnostics are unaffected. Create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_BINARY_PACKAGE_ROOT_PATH
description: Path to OVRTX binary package root. Loader uses for dylib and resources. Init and create_renderer (must match).

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_LOG_FILE_PATH
description: Log file path for carb logging. Applied when first renderer is created. Init and create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL
description: Log level for carb logging (e.g. "verbose", "info", "warn", "error"). Init and create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_ACTIVE_CUDA_GPUS
description: Comma-separated CUDA device indices to use (e.g. "0,1,2"). Create_renderer.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_DATASTORE_CACHE
description: Protocol-prefixed datastore cache configuration used by UJITSO. Supported values: "grpcdns://host:port", "grpcdns_notls://host:port", and "local://path". System-level; init and create_renderer values must match when both are specified.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SENSORS_ALLOWED_DEPRECATION_BASE
description: Allow all soft-deprecated sensor versions, but only while pinned to a specific framework release: "<major>.<minor>.<patch>". (e.g. "0.4.0"). Any other value (or unset) allows none.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SELECTION_OUTLINE_WIDTH
description: Selection outline width in pixels. Valid range 0..15 (15 is the underlying RTX outline pipeline cap). Init-time only; changing requires renderer recreation. Default: 2 (set by the underlying renderer).

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_SELECTION_FILL_MODE
description: Selection-outline interior (fill) mode. Value type: @ref ovrtx_selection_fill_mode_t. Out-of-range values are clamped by the renderer. Init-time only; changing requires renderer recreation. Default: @ref OVRTX_SELECTION_FILL_MODE_GLOBAL.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_MOTION_BVH
description: Motion BVH mode. Value type: @ref ovrtx_motion_bvh_t. Init-time only; changing requires renderer recreation. When not specified, defaults to @ref OVRTX_MOTION_BVH_DISABLE.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_INT64_DEPRECATED_4
description: Retired OVRTX_CONFIG_DOME_BAKING_RESOLUTION slot, replaced by the per-RenderProduct 'omni:rtx:lights:dome:baking:resolution' attribute. Passing this key returns an error. It shipped as 4 in ovrtx 0.4.1, so do not reuse the value for a new key: a config array built against those headers would then be misread as that key instead of rejected.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_TEXTURE_STREAMING_MODE
description: Texture streaming mode. Value type: @ref ovrtx_texture_streaming_mode_t. Invalid values cause renderer creation to fail. When omitted, defaults to @ref OVRTX_TEXTURE_STREAMING_ASYNCHRONOUS. Process-global; changing affects all active renderer instances.

name: OVRTX_CONFIG_AFTERMATH_MODE
description: NVIDIA Nsight Aftermath mode. Value type: @ref ovrtx_aftermath_mode_t. @ref OVRTX_AFTERMATH_DISABLE skips Aftermath initialization, @ref OVRTX_AFTERMATH_ENABLE selects explicit diagnostics initialization, and omitted or @ref OVRTX_AFTERMATH_AUTO selects the initialization mode automatically. This setting is process-global and must match the first renderer while the renderer system is alive.
